Scene widths

How many strips a scene occupies before the next begins. Each scene picks a random width in its range.

Scene joins

Join width is the crossfade where a new scene meets the old one. Repaint strength is how much the join zone is repainted: lower keeps more of both sides, higher makes a freer fusion.
